title: Production Python Node bypasses authenticated SCHC Rule-version policy
description: python/src/lichen/node.py ingress uses global decompress_packet() and records success without a LinkLayer-owned AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext; egress compresses before resolving next hop and discards _next_hop, so no peer version can be enforced. A signed peer with no version DIO or an incompatible v2 policy can deliver Rule 0/7, and the Node emits Rule 0/7 to incompatible/unadvertised peers. Require atomic current-generation per-signer policy for production ingress and resolved-next-hop egress; allow only bounded canonical Rule255 mismatch signaling. Add tests for missing DIO, v2 mismatch Rule0/7, Rule255, v3, rekey/stale races, and executable shared vectors.
notes: Independent rereview found originated/forwarded packets above the single-frame limit were dropped instead of using Link-issued fragmentation. Fixed with production helper regression.
